description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLanguageDao class, a Data Access Object responsible for CRUD operations and queries related to employee language information in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It interacts with Doctrine ORM to handle employee language records, including saving, retrieving, deleting, and filtering employee language data.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDao
classes.description: DAO class for managing EmployeeLanguage entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, complex queries, and pagination related to employees' language data.

methods.name: saveEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Persist an EmployeeLanguage entity into the database and return it.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Retrieve a specific EmployeeLanguage record based on employee number, language ID, and fluency ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeLanguageRecordsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetch existing language and fluency records for a given employee based on provided entries.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Delete specified language records for an employee.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Retrieve a list of EmployeeLanguage entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Count the number of EmployeeLanguage records matching the search criteria.

methods.name: getAllowedEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Get a list of languages allowed for an employee, according to filter parameters.

methods.name: getAllowedEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Count allowed languages for an employee matching the filter.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguagesPaginator
methods.description: Construct and return a paginator object for employee languages based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getAllowedEmployeeLanguagesPaginator
methods.description: Construct and return a paginator for allowed employee languages, including groupings and filters.
